question: What does a project usually cost?
answer: Identity work starts around €18,000 and a full site sits between €24,000 and €45,000 depending on how many templates it needs. I quote a fixed price after the first conversation, not an hourly rate.

question: How long will it take?
answer: Six to ten weeks for most of it. I run one project at a time, so the timeline you get is the timeline you get — there is nothing queued behind you.

question: Do you work with engineers, or do you build it?
answer: Both. I build marketing sites myself and hand production apps to your team as components with the states already drawn. I would rather draw the empty state than argue about it later.

question: Can you take on something small?
answer: Sometimes. A landing page, a type system, or a week of art direction all work well as a first project. Send the details and I will say yes or no within two days.
